findings.summary: 判据 2a (GT-19) is still not satisfied, and the new executing test pins the opposite of the criterion. The criterion demands the case «wall-clock budget still available but attempt count exhausted ⇒ the entry must continue», red when the limit logic reverts to count-primary. The delivered "discriminant" builds exactly that situation (DRAIN_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS=2400, DRAIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2) and asserts the entry STOPS (`expect(res.err).toContain("HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT")`), matching bin/e0-regression.sh:402-413, which breaks with LOOP_EXIT=4 whenever attempts are exhausted regardless of remaining wall clock. The companion executing case (:293-320, attempts=100 / wall=20) is insensitive to swapping the two checks — with 100 attempts the attempt branch can never fire, so reordering leaves it green. The only thing covering the ordering is therefore still the byte-offset text comparison at :256-263, which GT-23 names verbatim as unacceptable and which the previous final review already flagged as a blocker.

判据 1 («npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test» green on two consecutive runs; one flake counts as undelivered) is not credible with the two new 判据 2a cases. They execute the real entry with no --profile, so they load profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env and run a full real drain: live test bus 127.0.0.1:7495 with /data/agent-bus-test token, the live PRODUCTION bus (E0C1_PROD_BUS_URL is not overridden, so bin/e0-regression.sh:212 defaults to 127.0.0.1:7490 with the /data/agent-bus token), bun + /data/code/self/loop-engine/dist/cli.js, and real agent-run workers — all under a 120 000 ms execFileSync/vitest cap. bin/e0-regression.sh evaluates the wall clock only at the top of each iteration (:384-399), so drain #1 must complete in full before "HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT" can ever be printed, and the :322-346 case needs TWO complete drains plus a 5 s backoff inside 120 s, while profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env:45 records dr-worker-code-local ≈ 158 s and GT-18/GT-13 record drain rounds of ~2–3 minutes each. Any tick failure inside the drain — which §1.3's check-drain-failures now escalates loudly (bin/deep-research-loop.sh:219) — makes the entry break with LOOP_EXIT=5 and print neither limit line, so both assertions hinge on live research behaving a particular way. A hermetic harness that executes the same real entry in seconds already exists (test/e0c2-termination.test.ts:196-320: symlinked bin/e0-regression.sh + fake deep-research-loop stub + two fake buses, 30 s cap) and was not used.

判据 2b (GT-15/GT-16) is materially improved but still not discriminative. The case now drives a real runChannelWrite over a loopback HTTP fake bus and does assert `result.termination` is defined (both prior gaps), but the bound is derived from the very value it is supposed to protect: `halfTimeout = node_timeout * 1000 * 0.5`. Reverting §1.1 to node_timeout: 30 only shrinks the bound to 15 000 ms, and the seed board (one already-`explored` clue, AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS stubbed to 500 ms, node:child_process.spawn module-mocked file-wide at :102-115) finishes in milliseconds, so the required «撤回 §1.1 ⇒ 测试变红» still does not hold. A seed board whose only clue is terminal also exercises none of the `--run` side-effect path GT-13 identified as the slow one.

判据 3's triage case reimplements the production wait loop inside the test instead of driving it — the anti-pattern §5 records as the cause of 3 prior rejections. It imports readTriageResult/resolveAgentResultTimeout/hasRunExited and rebuilds the deadline/poll/exited-check sequence in the test body, so it asserts nothing about src/tick-run.ts:1638-1658; restoring a dead wait there leaves this case green. (The behaviour itself is genuinely covered by the 判据 2z case at :462-536, which drives runChannelWrite and asserts the named diagnostic, so this extra case adds only the anti-pattern.)

What is genuinely fixed relative to rf-attempt_01KZX7KGHVH9JMZQRB9FX4VM7R: (1) the typecheck break is gone — TerminationState and BoardState are now imported as types from ../src/tick (test/e0c9-node-timeout.test.ts:20) and both interfaces are exported at src/tick.ts:110 and src/tick.ts:333, so the helpers at :170-183 resolve. (2) The package's one mandated change is correct: workflows/deep-research/tick/workflow.yaml:14 sets node_timeout: 1800 with the arithmetic and the DEFAULT_AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS relation spelled out at :9-13, and the 判据 2 assertion (:195-203) compares against the recorded measured maximum 904.2 s × 1.99 rather than a source constant, so any value below 904.2 (including 900 and 30) turns it red. (3) 判据 2z drives runChannelWrite for both directions — triage run exited without result records and continues (src/tick-run.ts:1646-1651), bus unreachable still throws. (4) 判据 4 drives scripts/check-drain-failures.mjs as a subprocess for TIMEOUT, error=exec and the legacy EXIT:n shape.

This final judgment is formed independently of the Continuous review committed in the RC subject (rc-attempt_01KZX9ETF3NV2CFZ8JTATHZHT9, APPROVE with zero findings, reviewer glm/code-plan). That verdict is recorded but not adopted: it surfaces neither the unresolved 判据 2a discriminant nor the live-machine coupling of the two new executing cases.
